title: MTS12
source: Google Drive connector native Google Docs readback
scope: Full document tab, including the section labeled Working notes. I preserve text and order; this does not mark draft notes as accepted conclusions.
formatting_changes: I map Google Docs headings, emphasis, hyperlinks and lists to Markdown.
I map page breaks and soft line breaks to continuous Markdown spacing.
I retain role words but omit Google Docs font and ink styling.
I escape Markdown and HTML punctuation without changing rendered text.
